messages.name: Weyland-Yutani admin
messages.body: We stopped getting webhooks after our server was down over the weekend.

messages.name: Nora (Support Tier 2)
messages.body: Endpoints are disabled after 3 days of failed deliveries. Re-enable it under Settings > Developer > Webhooks. Each failed delivery is retried up to 8 times over 24 hours, so events from before that window are not resent; use the API to catch up.
